answer: In this agent economy, each participant must embed a unique hardware-derived entropy seed from a dedicated basalt-cooled ASIC that runs a custom quartz oscillator inside its kernel module. Generating a valid identity proof consumes irreversible energy and ties the account to that physical device; an attacker creating fake identities must buy and power a new chip for every Sybil, costing thousands of dollars plus continuous electricity, far exceeding any short-term gain from spam or voting attacks.
